2607.26791.title: SecRespond: Benchmarking AI Agents for Real-World Post-Compromise Incident Response
2607.26791.paper_summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly adopted in real-world security operations with access to host artifacts and command-line interfaces (CLIs), making it critical to thoroughly assess their security capabilities. However, existing cybersecurity benchmarks focus on pre-compromise settings where agents are placed in a clean and idealized environment before an attack occurs. This leaves the post-compromise setting underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce SecRespond, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on the post-compromise incident-response workflow. Given a forensic disk snapshot of a compromised host together with the alerts, vulnerability scans, and baseline checks reported by a host security product, agents are required to produce forensic reports on intrusions, baseline risks, and vulnerability risks, together with a remediation plan. We instantiate this task across 10 cyber ranges, each constructed from a distinct compromised cloud host, spanning 4 entry-point types, 21 ATT&CK techniques, and 5 operating systems. We evaluate 23 frontier LLMs on the OpenCode agent harness. Experimental results show that although current agents can reliably uncover the problems exposed by alerts, they struggle to proactively investigate the disk for silent intrusions and to produce comprehensive, verified remediation plans, with no model achieving complete detection and remediation on any single range. This reveals a fundamental bottleneck in building agents for real-world incident response. The benchmark is publicly available at https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr/tree/main/data/secrespond.
2607.26791.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理在現實世界的安全操作中越來越受到採用，並且可以訪問主機工件和命令行介面（CLI），使得徹底評估它們的安全能力變得至關重要。<lb/>然而，現有的網絡安全基準主要集中在預先妥協的設置中，這些代理在攻擊發生之前被放置在乾淨且理想化的環境中。<lb/>這使得事後妥協的設置未被充分探索。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們引入了SecRespond，這是第一個用於評估LLM代理在事後妥協事件響應工作流程中的基準。<lb/>給定一個妥協主機的取證磁碟快照，以及主機安全產品報告的警報、漏洞掃描和基準檢查，代理需要生成有關入侵、基準風險和漏洞風險的取證報告，以及修復計劃。<lb/>我們在10個網絡範圍內實現了這一任務，每個範圍都由一個不同的妥協雲主機構建，涵蓋4種入口點類型、21種ATT&CK技術和5種操作系統。<lb/>我們在OpenCode代理平台上評估了23個前沿LLM。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，儘管當前代理能夠可靠地發現警報所揭示的問題，但它們在主動調查磁碟以查找靜默入侵和生成全面、經過驗證的修復計劃方面存在困難，沒有任何模型在任何單一範圍內實現完全檢測和修復。<lb/>這揭示了為現實世界事件響應構建代理的根本瓶頸。<lb/>該基準可在https://github.com/Alibaba-NLP/qqr/tree/main/data/secrespond上公開獲得。
